svg.title: Coupling variables and directions between the atmosphere, land, sea ice and ocean
svg.desc: The atmosphere (lowest model level T, q, u, v and surface pressure p_s) exchanges with two branches that never share a grid point. Land: land_step() receives sensible and latent heat, net radiation, rain, snow and evaporation, and returns T_s, q_s, albedo, z_0 and r_h; excess bucket water leaves the system (no runoff). Ocean points: sea_step() sums the total heat flux, P-E, snowfall, surface stress and u_*^3 every step and returns T_s, q_s, albedo, z_0 and r_h blended by the ice cover c_i. At each coupling instant, sea_step() passes the window-mean fluxes to the sea ice module (ice_step()), which returns T_s, SST, MLD, ice cover, ice thickness and snow on ice. The sea ice passes ice cover, thickness, heat, P-E, snow, stress and u_*^3 to ocean_step(), which returns SST, MLD and the ocean heat flux.
svg.text: every step: accumulate fluxes at ocean points

text.tspan: At each coupling instant, pass the window-mean
fluxes to the sea ice module.
